dedupe_keys.name: a simulation based digital twin prototype for pressure reconstruction and burst response in water distribution networks

description: The study authors publish Python code, random seeds and JSON results for a water-network pressure digital-twin prototype. Zenodo provides three files free under CC BY 4.0. A Hazen–Williams gradient solver, learned hydraulic surrogate and streaming ensemble Kalman filter reconstruct nodal pressures from sparse sensors. Baselines use weighted least squares and an extended Kalman filter, with experiments on a one-hundred-node grid and EPANET Net3. The package can benchmark pressure reconstruction and emitter-burst response in distribution simulations. Related catalogue model-epanet is an independently developed engine used for solver comparison. Coverage is synthetic and benchmark networks, including an aged truth variant; field utility validation is not established. The deposit claims sub-millimetre solver agreement but that has not been reproduced. No Python code was executed or JSON results recalculated.
